youngest.translation: n. 年纪最小的人, 最小的儿子/女儿；[计] 最近期的

youngster.definition: n a young person of either sex
youngster.translation: n. 小孩, 年轻人, 少年；[法] 儿童, 少年, 青年

your.definition: pron. & a. The form of the possessive case of the personal；pronoun you.

yours.definition: pron. See the Note under Your.
yours.translation: pron. 你的(东西), 你们的(东西)

yourself.definition: pron. An emphasized or reflexive form of the pronoun of the；second person; -- used as a subject commonly with you; as, you yourself；shall see it; also, alone in the predicate, either in the nominative or；objective case; as, you have injured yourself.

youth.definition: n. the time of life between childhood and maturity；. early maturity; the state of being young or immature or inexperienced；. an early period of development；. the freshness and vitality characteristic of a young person
youth.translation: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春；[法] 青年, 青年时期, 青春时期

zebra.definition: n. any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines

zero.definition: n. a mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number；. the point on a scale from which positive or negative numerical quantities can be measured；. the sight setting that will cause a projectile to hit the center of the target with no wind blowing；v. adjust (an instrument or device) to zero value
zero.translation: n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点；a. 零的, 没有的；vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正；[计] 零

zi.translation: abbr. 美国本土, 后方地带（等于zone of interior）

zipper.definition: n a fastener for locking together two toothed edges by means of a sliding tab；v close with a zipper

zit.definition: n a small inflamed elevation of the skin; a pustule or papule; common symptom in acne

zone.definition: n. a locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features；. any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude；. an area or region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic；. (anatomy) any encircling or beltlike structure
zone.translation: n. 地带, 带, 地区；vt. 环绕, 使分成地带；vi. 分成区；[计] 卡片顶部的三行区; 区; 区域

zoo.definition: n the facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition

zz.translation: n. Z字形, 锯齿形（等于zigzag）
